14 Oct: US core CPI +0.3% m/m (2.6% y/y) against 0.2% expected; December Fed hike odds rose above 50%, clearing the CPI invalidator on the EUR/USD and GBP/USD shorts

15 Oct: Australian employment fell 39,300 and November RBA hike odds dropped to ~9% from 32%; UK August GDP printed +0.1% against an expected contraction; GBP/AUD rose 263 pips to 1.91865, through its 1.9160 stop

EUR/CAD and EUR/GBP both breached their published price invalidators on closing data between 8 and 15 Oct

OAT-Bund at 137.4bp on 16 Oct sits above the 125bp risk-dashboard threshold listed for AUD/CHF
Moody's review of France on 23 Oct and the French social security budget vote on 27 Oct, both new to the calendar
New Zealand general election on 7 Nov, ten days after the RBNZ decision
consensus_shifts: UBS, Manulife, Oxford Economics and Scotiabank pulled their BoC forecasts forward to an October hike, against USD/CAD, AUD/CAD and CAD/SGD
